title: Vocabulary gaps: synonyms, phrasal verbs, idioms, C1 words

word.example: Noa's room is always tidy: her books are on the shelf and her clothes are in the closet.

items.prompt: "Noa's room is always tidy: her books are on the shelf and her clothes are in the closet." Which word means the opposite of "tidy"?
items.audioText: Noa's room is always tidy: her books are on the shelf and her clothes are in the closet.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: המשפט מתאר ספרים על המדף ובגדים בארון. ההפך הוא חדר שהכול זרוק בו.
hints.en: Books on the shelf, clothes in the closet. The opposite is a room where things are everywhere.

explanation.he: tidy = מסודר. ההפך: messy = מבולגן. clean = נקי, וזה קרוב במשמעות ל־tidy ולא הפוך. small = קטן, quiet = שקט.
explanation.en: tidy means neat and in order. The opposite is messy. clean is close in meaning, not opposite.

word.example: It was rude of Eitan to look at his phone while his grandmother was talking to him.

items.prompt: "It was rude of Eitan to look at his phone while his grandmother was talking to him." Which word means the opposite of "rude"?
items.audioText: It was rude of Eitan to look at his phone while his grandmother was talking to him.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: האם זה יפה להסתכל בטלפון כשסבתא מדברת? ההפך הוא התנהגות יפה.
hints.en: Is it nice to look at your phone while Grandma is talking? The opposite is good manners.

explanation.he: rude = לא מנומס. ההפך: polite = מנומס. impolite פירושה בדיוק כמו rude, ולכן היא לא ההפך.
explanation.en: rude means not polite. The opposite is polite. impolite means the same as rude.

word.example: The new museum was built with money from a wealthy family who loved art.

items.prompt: "The new museum was built with money from a wealthy family who loved art." Which word means almost the same as "wealthy"?
items.audioText: The new museum was built with money from a wealthy family who loved art.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: למשפחה היה הרבה כסף כדי לבנות מוזיאון.
hints.en: The family had a lot of money to build a museum.

explanation.he: wealthy = עשיר, כמו rich. healthy = בריא, היא רק נשמעת דומה. famous = מפורסם, large = גדול.
explanation.en: wealthy means rich. healthy only sounds similar.

word.example: The magician waved his hand, and the coin vanished.

items.prompt: "The magician waved his hand, and the coin vanished." Which word means almost the same as "vanished"?
items.audioText: The magician waved his hand, and the coin vanished.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: מה קוסם עושה למטבע?
hints.en: What does a magician do to a coin?

explanation.he: vanish = להיעלם, כמו disappear. appeared = הופיע, וזה ההפך. rolled = התגלגל, broke = נשבר.
explanation.en: vanish means disappear. appear is the opposite.

word.example: You can purchase tickets for the concert online or at the entrance.

items.prompt: "You can purchase tickets for the concert online or at the entrance." Which word means almost the same as "purchase"?
items.audioText: You can purchase tickets for the concert online or at the entrance.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: מה עושים עם כרטיסים לפני הופעה, באינטרנט או בכניסה?
hints.en: What do you do with tickets before a concert?

explanation.he: purchase = לרכוש, לקנות, כמו buy. זו מילה רשמית יותר. sell = למכור, וזה ההפך.
explanation.en: purchase is a formal word for buy. sell is the opposite.

word.example: Our neighbor is very generous: she always shares the vegetables from her garden with everyone on the street.

items.prompt: "Our neighbor is very generous: she always shares the vegetables from her garden with everyone on the street." Which word means the opposite of "generous"?
items.audioText: Our neighbor is very generous: she always shares the vegetables from her garden with everyone on the street.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: השכנה מחלקת ירקות לכולם. ההפך הוא מישהו שחושב רק על עצמו.
hints.en: She shares with everyone. The opposite is someone who thinks only about themselves.

explanation.he: generous = נדיב, מישהו שאוהב לתת. ההפך: selfish = אנוכי. kind = נחמד, טוב לב, וזה קרוב ל־generous ולא הפוך.
explanation.en: generous means happy to give. The opposite is selfish. kind is close in meaning.

word.example: Dad was furious when he saw the long scratch on his new car.

items.prompt: "Dad was furious when he saw the long scratch on his new car." Which word means almost the same as "furious"?
items.audioText: Dad was furious when he saw the long scratch on his new car.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: איך מרגישים כשרואים שריטה על מכונית חדשה?
hints.en: How do you feel when you see a scratch on your new car?

explanation.he: furious = זועם, כועס מאוד. very calm = רגוע מאוד, וזה ההפך. excited = נרגש, וזה רגש שמח.
explanation.en: furious means very angry.

word.example: He tried to conceal his disappointment, but his face showed how he really felt.

items.prompt: "He tried to conceal his disappointment, but his face showed how he really felt." Which word means almost the same as "conceal"?
items.audioText: He tried to conceal his disappointment, but his face showed how he really felt.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: but his face showed: הוא ניסה לעשות את ההפך מ־show.
hints.en: but his face showed: he tried to do the opposite of show.

explanation.he: conceal = להסתיר, כמו hide. show = להראות, וזה ההפך. המילה but מראה שהניסיון להסתיר לא הצליח.
explanation.en: conceal means hide. show is the opposite.

word.example: The principal rejected our plan for a school garden because it was too expensive.

items.prompt: "The principal rejected our plan for a school garden because it was too expensive." Which word means the opposite of "rejected"?
items.audioText: The principal rejected our plan for a school garden because it was too expensive.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: because it was too expensive: המנהל אמר לא. מה ההפך מלומר לא לתוכנית?
hints.en: It was too expensive, so the answer was no. What is the opposite of saying no to a plan?

explanation.he: reject = לדחות, לא להסכים. ההפך: accept = לקבל, לאשר. refused = סירב, וזה קרוב ל־rejected ולא הפוך.
explanation.en: reject means say no to something. The opposite is accept. refuse is close in meaning.

word.example: The water at this end of the pool is shallow, so small children can play here safely.

items.prompt: "The water at this end of the pool is shallow, so small children can play here safely." Which word means the opposite of "shallow"?
items.audioText: The water at this end of the pool is shallow, so small children can play here safely.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: ילדים קטנים יכולים לשחק כאן בבטחה. מה ההפך ממים שעומדים בהם בקלות?
hints.en: Small children are safe here. What is the opposite of water you can easily stand in?

explanation.he: shallow = רדוד, לא עמוק. ההפך: deep = עמוק. low = נמוך, וזה קרוב במשמעות ל־shallow ולא הפוך.
explanation.en: shallow means not deep. The opposite is deep.

word.example: Be careful with that box: there are fragile glasses inside.

items.prompt: "Be careful with that box: there are fragile glasses inside." Which word means almost the same as "fragile"?
items.audioText: Be careful with that box: there are fragile glasses inside.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: למה צריך להיזהר עם קופסה שיש בה כוסות?
hints.en: Why must you be careful with a box of glasses?

explanation.he: fragile = שביר, כמו breakable. strong = חזק, וזה ההפך. expensive = יקר, heavy = כבד. גם הם סיבות להיזהר, אבל זה לא הפירוש של fragile.
explanation.en: fragile means easily broken, like breakable. strong is the opposite.

word.example: Two parents will assist the teacher on the class trip to the Galilee.

items.prompt: "Two parents will assist the teacher on the class trip to the Galilee." Which word means almost the same as "assist"?
items.audioText: Two parents will assist the teacher on the class trip to the Galilee.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: מה הורים עושים בטיול כדי שיהיה למורה קל יותר?
hints.en: What do parents do on a trip to make it easier for the teacher?

explanation.he: assist = לסייע, לעזור, כמו help. replace = להחליף, follow = ללכת אחרי, warn = להזהיר.
explanation.en: assist is a formal word for help.

word.example: The recipe gives precise amounts, so measure the flour carefully.

items.prompt: "The recipe gives precise amounts, so measure the flour carefully." Which word means almost the same as "precise"?
items.audioText: The recipe gives precise amounts, so measure the flour carefully.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: so measure carefully: למה צריך למדוד בזהירות?
hints.en: Why do you need to measure carefully?

explanation.he: precise = מדויק, כמו exact. rough = משוער, בערך, וזה ההפך. large = גדול, simple = פשוט.
explanation.en: precise means exact. rough means approximate, the opposite.

word.example: Even after she won the prize, the scientist stayed humble and thanked her whole team.

items.prompt: "Even after she won the prize, the scientist stayed humble and thanked her whole team." Which word means the opposite of "humble"?
items.audioText: Even after she won the prize, the scientist stayed humble and thanked her whole team.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: היא הודתה לכל הצוות ולא אמרה שהיא הכי טובה. ההפך הוא מישהו שחושב שהוא יותר טוב מכולם.
hints.en: She thanked her team. The opposite is someone who thinks they are better than everyone.

explanation.he: humble = צנוע. ההפך: arrogant = יהיר, שחצן. modest פירושה גם צנוע, ולכן היא לא ההפך.
explanation.en: humble means not proud of yourself. The opposite is arrogant. modest means the same as humble.

word.example: Power cuts are frequent in the village during winter storms.

items.prompt: "Power cuts are frequent in the village during winter storms." Which word means the opposite of "frequent"?
items.audioText: Power cuts are frequent in the village during winter storms.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: frequent קשורה ל־how often. ההפך הוא משהו שכמעט לא קורה.
hints.en: frequent is about how often. The opposite is something that almost never happens.

explanation.he: frequent = קורה לעתים קרובות. ההפך: rare = נדיר. common = נפוץ, וזה קרוב ל־frequent ולא הפוך.
explanation.en: frequent means happening often. The opposite is rare. common is close in meaning.

word.example: Be cautious when you cross this road: the cars drive very fast.

items.prompt: "Be cautious when you cross this road: the cars drive very fast." Which word means almost the same as "cautious"?
items.audioText: Be cautious when you cross this road: the cars drive very fast.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: המכוניות נוסעות מהר. איך כדאי לחצות את הכביש?
hints.en: The cars are fast. How should you cross the road?

explanation.he: cautious = זהיר, כמו careful. careless = לא זהיר, וזה ההפך. הסיומת less פירושה בלי.
explanation.en: cautious means careful. careless is the opposite.

word.example: The expert examined the old coin and said that it was genuine.

items.prompt: "The expert examined the old coin and said that it was genuine." Which word means the opposite of "genuine"?
items.audioText: The expert examined the old coin and said that it was genuine.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: מומחה בודק מטבע כדי לדעת אם הוא אמיתי. מה ההפך?
hints.en: An expert checks if a coin is real. What is the opposite?

explanation.he: genuine = אמיתי, מקורי. ההפך: fake = מזויף. real = אמיתי, וזה בדיוק כמו genuine. valuable = בעל ערך, heavy = כבד.
explanation.en: genuine means real. The opposite is fake. real means the same as genuine.

word.example: Maya is optimistic about the final: she thinks her team can win.

items.prompt: "Maya is optimistic about the final: she thinks her team can win." Which word means the opposite of "optimistic"?
items.audioText: Maya is optimistic about the final: she thinks her team can win.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: she thinks her team can win: היא מצפה לטוב. ההפך הוא מישהו שמצפה לרע.
hints.en: She expects good things. The opposite is someone who expects bad things.

explanation.he: optimistic = אופטימי, מצפה לטוב. ההפך: pessimistic = פסימי, מצפה לרע. hopeful = מלא תקווה, וזה קרוב ל־optimistic ולא הפוך.
explanation.en: optimistic means expecting good things. The opposite is pessimistic. hopeful is close in meaning.

word.example: The company plans to expand and open three new stores next year.

items.prompt: "The company plans to expand and open three new stores next year." Which word means the opposite of "expand"?
items.audioText: The company plans to expand and open three new stores next year.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: open three new stores: החברה נעשית גדולה יותר. מה ההפך?
hints.en: Three new stores: the company gets bigger. What is the opposite?

explanation.he: expand = להתרחב, לגדול. ההפך: shrink = להתכווץ, לקטון. grow = לגדול, וזה קרוב ל־expand ולא הפוך.
explanation.en: expand means get bigger. The opposite is shrink. grow is close in meaning.

word.example: Rex is a loyal dog: he waits by the door every day until the children come home.

items.prompt: "Rex is a loyal dog: he waits by the door every day until the children come home." Which word means almost the same as "loyal"?
items.audioText: Rex is a loyal dog: he waits by the door every day until the children come home.

instruction.he: לבחור מילה שפירושה כמעט אותו דבר
instruction.en: Choose the word that means almost the same

hints.he: הכלב מחכה לילדים כל יום. מה זה אומר על היחס שלו אליהם?
hints.en: The dog waits for the children every day. What does it show about him?

explanation.he: loyal = נאמן, כמו faithful. lazy = עצלן, clever = חכם, wild = פראי. אף אחת מהן לא אומרת נאמן.
explanation.en: loyal means faithful: always staying with and supporting someone.

word.example: In the desert, water is scarce, so every drop is precious.

items.prompt: "In the desert, water is scarce, so every drop is precious." Which word means the opposite of "scarce"?
items.audioText: In the desert, water is scarce, so every drop is precious.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: every drop is precious: יש מעט מים. ההפך הוא שיש הרבה.
hints.en: Every drop is precious: there is little water. The opposite is a lot.

explanation.he: scarce = מועט, יש ממנו מעט מאוד. ההפך: plentiful = מצוי בשפע. rare = נדיר, וזה קרוב ל־scarce ולא הפוך.
explanation.en: scarce means there is very little of it. The opposite is plentiful. rare is close in meaning.

word.example: The cat was hostile to the new puppy and hissed at it all day.

items.prompt: "The cat was hostile to the new puppy and hissed at it all day." Which word means the opposite of "hostile"?
items.audioText: The cat was hostile to the new puppy and hissed at it all day.

instruction.en: Choose the word with the opposite meaning

hints.he: החתולה נשפה על הגור כל היום. ההפך הוא התנהגות חמה ונעימה.
hints.en: The cat hissed all day. The opposite is warm, nice behavior.

explanation.he: hostile = עוין, לא ידידותי. ההפך: friendly = ידידותי. unfriendly פירושה כמעט כמו hostile, ולכן היא לא ההפך.
explanation.en: hostile means unfriendly and ready to fight. The opposite is friendly.

items.prompt: I can't ___ this noise any longer. I'm going to talk to the neighbors.
items.audioText: I can't put up with this noise any longer. I'm going to talk to the neighbors.

hints.he: הדובר כבר לא יכול לסבול את הרעש.
hints.en: The speaker can't stand the noise anymore.

explanation.he: put up with = לסבול, להשלים עם משהו לא נעים. put down = להניח, put away = להחזיר למקום.
explanation.en: put up with = accept something unpleasant. put down = place on a surface. put away = put back in its place.

items.prompt: "We got lost and ended up in a small village we had never heard of." What does "ended up" mean?
items.audioText: We got lost and ended up in a small village we had never heard of.

hints.he: they got lost: האם הם תכננו להגיע לכפר?
hints.en: They got lost. Did they plan to get to the village?

explanation.he: end up = למצוא את עצמך בסוף במקום או במצב, בלי שתכננת. בעברית אפשר לומר 'בסוף הגענו ל...'.
explanation.en: end up = finally be in a place or situation you didn't plan.

items.prompt: The test looked hard, but it ___ that I knew most of the answers.
items.audioText: The test looked hard, but it turned out that I knew most of the answers.

hints.he: but: משהו התברר בסוף, אחרי שהמבחן נראה קשה.
hints.en: but: something became clear in the end.

explanation.he: it turned out that = התברר ש. turn off = לכבות, turn over = להפוך לצד השני.
explanation.en: it turned out that = in the end, it became clear that. turn off = stop a machine. turn over = flip.

items.prompt: The teacher ___ a few spelling mistakes in my essay.
items.audioText: The teacher pointed out a few spelling mistakes in my essay.

hints.he: מה המורה עשתה עם הטעויות? היא הראתה אותן לי.
hints.en: What did the teacher do with the mistakes? She showed them to me.

explanation.he: point out = להצביע על, להעיר על משהו כדי שמישהו ישים לב. give out = לחלק, go out = לצאת.
explanation.en: point out = show or tell someone about something. give out = hand out. go out = leave.

items.prompt: "While cleaning the storage room, I came across some old letters from my grandfather." What does "came across" mean?
items.audioText: While cleaning the storage room, I came across some old letters from my grandfather.

hints.he: האם הדובר חיפש את המכתבים?
hints.en: Was the speaker looking for the letters?

explanation.he: come across = למצוא במקרה, להיתקל במשהו. across לא אומר כאן לעבור מעל משהו.
explanation.en: come across = find something by chance.

items.prompt: Start walking without me. I'll ___ you before you reach the bus stop.
items.audioText: Start walking without me. I'll catch up with you before you reach the bus stop.

hints.he: הדובר יוצא אחריהם ורוצה להגיע אליהם בדרך.
hints.en: The speaker leaves later and wants to reach them on the way.

explanation.he: catch up with = להשיג מישהו שהקדים אותך, להדביק אותו. run out of = לגמור משהו (שנגמר המלאי), look up to = להעריץ.
explanation.en: catch up with = reach someone who is ahead of you.

items.prompt: "Tamar really looks up to her older sister, who is a doctor." What does "looks up to" mean?
items.audioText: Tamar really looks up to her older sister, who is a doctor.

hints.he: איך מרגישים לפעמים כלפי אחות גדולה שהיא רופאה?
hints.en: How might you feel about an older sister who is a doctor?

explanation.he: look up to = להעריץ, להעריך מאוד ולראות בו דוגמה. זה לא קשור להסתכל למעלה. ההפך: look down on = לזלזל.
explanation.en: look up to = admire and respect someone. The opposite is look down on.

items.prompt: Ido ___ his father: they both have curly hair and love to tell jokes.
items.audioText: Ido takes after his father: they both have curly hair and love to tell jokes.

hints.he: עידו ואבא שלו דומים במראה ובאופי.
hints.en: Ido and his father are similar in looks and character.

explanation.he: take after = להיות דומה להורה או לקרוב משפחה מבוגר. take over = להשתלט, לקחת אחריות. take off = להמריא, להוריד בגד.
explanation.en: take after = be like an older family member. take over = take control. take off = leave the ground, remove clothes.

items.prompt: "I promised to help Yael move to her new flat, so I can't let her down." What does "let her down" mean?
items.audioText: I promised to help Yael move to her new flat, so I can't let her down.

hints.he: הבטחתי. מה קורה אם לא מקיימים הבטחה?
hints.en: I promised. What happens if you break a promise?

explanation.he: let someone down = לאכזב מישהו שסמך עלינו.
explanation.en: let someone down = disappoint someone who trusted you.

items.prompt: "I ran into my old teacher at the supermarket yesterday." What does "ran into" mean?
items.audioText: I ran into my old teacher at the supermarket yesterday.

hints.he: האם הדובר תכנן לפגוש את המורה בסופר?
hints.en: Did the speaker plan to meet the teacher?

explanation.he: run into someone = לפגוש מישהו במקרה, להיתקל בו. לא צריך לרוץ ולא להתנגש.
explanation.en: run into someone = meet them by chance.

items.prompt: Ari asked for a dog for months, and in the end his parents ___.
items.audioText: Ari asked for a dog for months, and in the end his parents gave in.

hints.he: ההורים סירבו הרבה זמן. מה קרה בסוף?
hints.en: The parents said no for a long time. What happened in the end?

explanation.he: give in = להיכנע, להסכים אחרי שהתנגדת הרבה זמן. give away = לתת במתנה, give back = להחזיר. שני אלה צריכים מושא (משהו).
explanation.en: give in = finally agree after saying no. give away and give back need an object.

items.prompt: "In her bright red coat, she really stood out in the crowd." What does "stood out" mean?
items.audioText: In her bright red coat, she really stood out in the crowd.

hints.he: מעיל אדום בוהק בתוך קהל: מה קורה כשמסתכלים?
hints.en: A bright red coat in a crowd: what happens when people look?

explanation.he: stand out = לבלוט, למשוך תשומת לב כי משהו או מישהו שונה מהשאר.
explanation.en: stand out = be easy to notice because you are different.

items.prompt: He ___ of university after one year to start his own company.
items.audioText: He dropped out of university after one year to start his own company.

hints.he: הוא עזב את הלימודים לפני שסיים.
hints.en: He left his studies before finishing.

explanation.he: drop out (of) = לנשור, לעזוב לימודים באמצע. drop off = להוריד מישהו ברכב, drop in = לקפוץ לביקור.
explanation.en: drop out of = leave school or university before finishing. drop off = take someone somewhere by car. drop in = visit briefly.

items.prompt: We ___ early in the morning to avoid the heat on the trail.
items.audioText: We set off early in the morning to avoid the heat on the trail.

hints.he: מה עושים בבוקר מוקדם לפני טיול?
hints.en: What do you do early in the morning before a hike?

explanation.he: set off = לצאת לדרך. set back = לעכב, set aside = לשים בצד, לחסוך.
explanation.en: set off = start a journey. set back = delay. set aside = keep for later.

items.prompt: "Don't worry about the problem with your phone. We'll sort it out tomorrow." What does "sort it out" mean?
items.audioText: Don't worry about the problem with your phone. We'll sort it out tomorrow.

hints.he: יש בעיה בטלפון. מה עושים עם בעיה?
hints.en: There is a problem. What do you do with a problem?

explanation.he: sort out = לסדר, לפתור בעיה. sort לבד = למיין, אבל sort out a problem = לפתור אותה.
explanation.en: sort out a problem = solve it.

items.prompt: Ella walks so fast that I can hardly ___ her.
items.audioText: Ella walks so fast that I can hardly keep up with her.

hints.he: אלה הולכת מהר. מה קשה לדובר?
hints.en: Ella walks fast. What is hard for the speaker?

explanation.he: keep up with = לעמוד בקצב של מישהו, לא לפגר אחריו. keep off = לא לעלות על, להתרחק. keep out of = לא להיכנס ל.
explanation.en: keep up with = move at the same speed as someone. keep off = stay away from. keep out of = not enter.

items.prompt: "Dana and Shira fell out over a silly argument, and they haven't spoken since." What does "fell out" mean?
items.audioText: Dana and Shira fell out over a silly argument, and they haven't spoken since.

hints.he: they haven't spoken since: מה קרה ביניהן?
hints.en: They haven't spoken since. What happened between them?

explanation.he: fall out (with someone) = לריב עם מישהו ולהפסיק להיות חברים. בעברית: 'הן הסתכסכו'.
explanation.en: fall out with someone = argue and stop being friends.

items.prompt: Please ___. It's only a small scratch, and it will heal soon.
items.audioText: Please calm down. It's only a small scratch, and it will heal soon.

hints.he: אומרים למישהו שזו רק שריטה קטנה. מה רוצים שירגיש?
hints.en: It's only a small scratch. How should the person feel?

explanation.he: calm down = להירגע. show off = להשוויץ, take off = להמריא, להוריד בגד.
explanation.en: calm down = become relaxed again. show off = try to impress. take off = leave the ground, remove clothes.

items.prompt: "The broken window is just the tip of the iceberg: the whole building needs repairs." What does the speaker mean?
items.audioText: The broken window is just the tip of the iceberg: the whole building needs repairs.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.he: the whole building needs repairs: החלון הוא רק חלק קטן.
hints.en: The whole building needs repairs: the window is only a small part.

explanation.he: the tip of the iceberg = קצה הקרחון. בדיוק כמו בעברית: מה שרואים הוא רק חלק קטן מבעיה גדולה בהרבה.
explanation.en: the tip of the iceberg = a small part of a much bigger problem.

items.prompt: "We collected 200 shekels for the new hospital wing, but it needs millions. It's a drop in the ocean." What does the speaker mean?
items.audioText: We collected 200 shekels for the new hospital wing, but it needs millions. It's a drop in the ocean.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: It's a tiny amount compared to what is needed.
The money fell into the sea.

hints.he: השוו 200 שקלים למיליונים.
hints.en: Compare 200 shekels to millions.

explanation.he: a drop in the ocean = טיפה בים. כמו בעברית: כמות קטנה מאוד לעומת מה שצריך.
explanation.en: a drop in the ocean = a very small amount compared to what is needed.

items.prompt: "Don't worry, you're not the only one who failed the quiz. We're all in the same boat." What does the speaker mean?
items.audioText: Don't worry, you're not the only one who failed the quiz. We're all in the same boat.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: We all have the same problem.
We are all going on a boat trip.
We all sit at the same table.

hints.he: you're not the only one who failed: מה משותף לכולם?
hints.en: You're not the only one who failed. What do they all share?

explanation.he: in the same boat = באותה סירה. כמו בעברית: כולנו באותו מצב קשה.
explanation.en: in the same boat = in the same difficult situation.

items.prompt: "They were already arguing, and his rude joke only added fuel to the fire." What did the joke do?
items.audioText: They were already arguing, and his rude joke only added fuel to the fire.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.he: they were already arguing: הוויכוח כבר היה. מה הבדיחה הגסה עשתה לו?
hints.en: They were already arguing. What did the rude joke do to it?

explanation.he: add fuel to the fire = להוסיף שמן למדורה. כמו בעברית: להחמיר מצב שכבר רע.
explanation.en: add fuel to the fire = make a bad situation worse.

items.prompt: "Everyone shouted about the new lunch menu, but it was a storm in a teacup, and by Friday nobody cared." What does the speaker mean?
items.audioText: Everyone shouted about the new lunch menu, but it was a storm in a teacup, and by Friday nobody cared.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: People got upset about something unimportant.
There was bad weather at lunch.
It was a serious problem that lasted long.

hints.he: by Friday nobody cared: האם זה היה חשוב באמת?
hints.en: By Friday nobody cared. Was it really important?

explanation.he: a storm in a teacup = סערה בכוס מים. כמו בעברית: הרבה רעש על דבר לא חשוב.
explanation.en: a storm in a teacup = a lot of anger about something unimportant.

items.prompt: "Nobody mentioned the bad grades at dinner. They were the elephant in the room." What were the bad grades?
items.audioText: Nobody mentioned the bad grades at dinner. They were the elephant in the room.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: An obvious problem everyone avoided talking about
A big, noisy guest at dinner
A topic everyone loved to discuss

hints.he: nobody mentioned: כולם ידעו, אבל אף אחד לא דיבר.
hints.en: Nobody mentioned it: everyone knew, but nobody spoke.

explanation.he: the elephant in the room = הפיל שבחדר. כמו בעברית: בעיה גדולה שכולם רואים ואף אחד לא מדבר עליה.
explanation.en: the elephant in the room = a big problem everyone knows about but nobody talks about.

items.prompt: "Stop beating around the bush and tell me what happened to my bike!" What does the speaker want?
items.audioText: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what happened to my bike!

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: To hear the main point directly
To work in the garden together
To hear the story more slowly

hints.he: tell me what happened: הדובר רוצה לשמוע את העיקר.
hints.en: tell me what happened: the speaker wants the main point.

explanation.he: beat around the bush = לדבר מסביב, לא לגשת ישר לעניין. בעברית אומרים גם 'למרוח'.
explanation.en: beat around the bush = avoid saying the important thing directly.

items.prompt: "The computer crashed before I saved my project, so I'm back to square one." What does the speaker mean?
items.audioText: The computer crashed before I saved my project, so I'm back to square one.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: I have to start again from the beginning.
I'm going back to my first school.

hints.he: before I saved: מה קרה לכל העבודה?
hints.en: before I saved: what happened to all the work?

explanation.he: back to square one = חזרה לנקודת ההתחלה. כל ההתקדמות אבדה וצריך להתחיל מחדש.
explanation.en: back to square one = back at the start, with no progress.

items.prompt: "The tickets sold out in an hour. If you didn't buy one this morning, you missed the boat." What does the speaker mean?
items.audioText: The tickets sold out in an hour. If you didn't buy one this morning, you missed the boat.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: You arrived late at the port.

hints.he: the tickets sold out: אפשר עוד לקנות?
hints.en: The tickets sold out. Can you still buy one?

explanation.he: miss the boat = לפספס את ההזדמנות. בעברית אומרים 'לפספס את הרכבת'. באנגלית זו סירה.
explanation.en: miss the boat = lose a chance because you were too slow.

items.prompt: "Our coach always goes the extra mile: she stays after practice to help anyone who needs it." What does the coach do?
items.audioText: Our coach always goes the extra mile: she stays after practice to help anyone who needs it.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: She does more than she has to.

hints.he: she stays after practice: האם היא חייבת?
hints.en: She stays after practice. Does she have to?

explanation.he: go the extra mile = לעשות יותר ממה שצריך, להשקיע מאמץ נוסף. בעברית אפשר לומר 'ללכת עוד צעד'.
explanation.en: go the extra mile = do more than you have to.

items.prompt: "The builders cut corners to finish early, and now the roof leaks." What did the builders do?
items.audioText: The builders cut corners to finish early, and now the roof leaks.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: They did the work cheaply and badly.

hints.he: now the roof leaks: איך הם עבדו?
hints.en: Now the roof leaks. How did they work?

explanation.he: cut corners = לעגל פינות. כמו בעברית: לעבוד מהר ובזול על חשבון האיכות.
explanation.en: cut corners = do something quickly or cheaply and badly.

items.prompt: "As a rule of thumb, drink a glass of water every time you drink coffee." What is "a rule of thumb"?
items.audioText: As a rule of thumb, drink a glass of water every time you drink coffee.

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: A way to measure your finger

hints.he: זו עצה מעשית, לא חוק.
hints.en: It is practical advice, not a law.

explanation.he: a rule of thumb = כלל אצבע. כמו בעברית: עצה פשוטה ומעשית שבדרך כלל נכונה, לא כלל מדויק.
explanation.en: a rule of thumb = a simple, practical guideline that is usually right.

word.example: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently.

items.prompt: ambiguous
items.audioText: ambiguous

hints.he: המילה במשפט: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently.

explanation.he: ambiguous פירושה דו־משמעי, לא חד. דוגמה: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently. לא להתבלבל עם ambitious = שאפתני.
explanation.en: ambiguous means having more than one possible meaning. Example: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently.

word.example: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently.

items.prompt: דו־משמעי (אפשר להבין בכמה דרכים)

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות a
hints.en: It starts with a

hints.he: יש בה 9 אותיות.
hints.en: It has 9 letters.

explanation.he: דו־משמעי, לא חד באנגלית: ambiguous. דוגמה: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently.
explanation.en: The word is ambiguous (having more than one possible meaning). Example: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently.

word.example: The question was ambiguous, so half the class understood it differently.

items.prompt: The instructions were so ___ that every student understood them in a different way.
items.audioText: The instructions were so ambiguous that every student understood them in a different way.

hints.he: כל תלמיד הבין אחרת. מה הבעיה בהוראות?
hints.en: Every student understood differently. What was wrong with the instructions?

explanation.he: ambiguous = דו־משמעי. הוראות שאפשר להבין בכמה דרכים. ambitious = שאפתני, accurate = מדויק, efficient = יעיל.
explanation.en: Instructions that can be understood in more than one way are ambiguous.

word.example: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.

items.prompt: feasible
items.audioText: feasible

hints.he: המילה במשפט: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.

explanation.he: feasible פירושה בר־ביצוע, אפשרי מעשית. דוגמה: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.
explanation.en: feasible means possible to do in practice. Example: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.

word.example: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.

items.prompt: בר־ביצוע (אפשר לעשות את זה בפועל)

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות f
hints.en: It starts with f

hints.he: יש בה 8 אותיות.
hints.en: It has 8 letters.

explanation.he: בר־ביצוע, אפשרי מעשית באנגלית: feasible. דוגמה: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.
explanation.en: The word is feasible (possible to do in practice). Example: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.

word.example: Building the new bridge in one year is not feasible.

items.prompt: With only two weeks and no money, the plan simply isn't ___.
items.audioText: With only two weeks and no money, the plan simply isn't feasible.

hints.he: שבועיים ובלי כסף: אפשר בכלל לבצע את התוכנית?
hints.en: Two weeks and no money: can the plan be done at all?

explanation.he: feasible = בר־ביצוע. בלי זמן ובלי כסף אי אפשר לבצע את התוכנית. mutual = הדדי, reluctant = מסרב, לא רוצה, prevalent = נפוץ.
explanation.en: A plan that can really be done is feasible. Without time or money, it isn't.

word.example: The school will implement the new rules next month.

items.prompt: implement
items.audioText: implement

hints.he: המילה במשפט: The school will implement the new rules next month.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: The school will implement the new rules next month.

explanation.he: implement פירושה ליישם, להוציא לפועל. דוגמה: The school will implement the new rules next month.
explanation.en: implement means put a plan into action. Example: The school will implement the new rules next month.

word.example: The school will implement the new rules next month.

items.prompt: ליישם (להוציא תוכנית לפועל)

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות i
hints.en: It starts with i

hints.he: יש בה 9 אותיות.
hints.en: It has 9 letters.

explanation.he: ליישם, להוציא לפועל באנגלית: implement. דוגמה: The school will implement the new rules next month.
explanation.en: The word is implement (put a plan into action). Example: The school will implement the new rules next month.

word.example: The school will implement the new rules next month.

items.prompt: The city council approved the plan, but it will take two years to ___ it.
items.audioText: The city council approved the plan, but it will take two years to implement it.

hints.he: התוכנית אושרה. מה עושים איתה עכשיו?
hints.en: The plan was approved. What happens to it now?

explanation.he: implement a plan = ליישם תוכנית, להוציא אותה לפועל. imply = לרמוז, impress = להרשים, insist = להתעקש.
explanation.en: You implement a plan when you put it into action.

word.example: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year.

items.prompt: allocate
items.audioText: allocate

hints.he: המילה במשפט: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year.

explanation.he: allocate פירושה להקצות. דוגמה: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year. לא להתבלבל עם locate = לאתר.
explanation.en: allocate means give an amount of something for a purpose. Example: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year.

word.example: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year.

items.prompt: להקצות (לתת כסף או זמן למטרה מסוימת)

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות a
hints.en: It starts with a

hints.he: יש בה 8 אותיות.
hints.en: It has 8 letters.

explanation.he: להקצות באנגלית: allocate. דוגמה: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year.
explanation.en: The word is allocate (give an amount of something for a purpose). Example: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year.

word.example: The government allocated more money to hospitals this year.

items.prompt: Next year the school will ___ more hours to science and fewer to sport.
items.audioText: Next year the school will allocate more hours to science and fewer to sport.

hints.he: שעות למדע: מחליטים כמה שעות לתת לכל מקצוע.
hints.en: Hours for science: deciding how many hours each subject gets.

explanation.he: allocate X to Y = להקצות X ל־Y. accuse = להאשים, abolish = לבטל, admire = להעריץ.
explanation.en: You allocate time or money to a purpose.

word.example: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.

items.prompt: subsequent
items.audioText: subsequent

hints.he: המילה במשפט: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.

explanation.he: subsequent פירושה שבא אחר כך, הבא. דוגמה: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.
explanation.en: subsequent means coming after something else. Example: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.

word.example: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.

items.prompt: שבא אחרי, שלאחר מכן (תואר)

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות s
hints.en: It starts with s

hints.he: יש בה 10 אותיות.
hints.en: It has 10 letters.

explanation.he: שבא אחר כך, הבא באנגלית: subsequent. דוגמה: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.
explanation.en: The word is subsequent (coming after something else). Example: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.

word.example: The first test was hard, but the subsequent tests were easier.

items.prompt: The first experiment failed, but ___ experiments were much more successful.
items.audioText: The first experiment failed, but subsequent experiments were much more successful.

hints.he: the first experiment: איזה ניסויים יכולים לבוא אחרי הראשון?
hints.en: the first experiment: which experiments can come after the first?

explanation.he: subsequent = שבאו אחר כך. previous = קודמים, אבל לניסוי הראשון אין ניסויים קודמים. reluctant = לא רוצה, jealous = מקנא.
explanation.en: subsequent means coming after. Nothing comes before the first experiment, so previous is wrong.

word.example: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.

items.prompt: fluctuate
items.audioText: fluctuate

hints.he: המילה במשפט: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.

explanation.he: fluctuate פירושה לעלות ולרדת, להשתנות שוב ושוב. דוגמה: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.
explanation.en: fluctuate means go up and down again and again. Example: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.

word.example: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.

items.prompt: לעלות ולרדת שוב ושוב (מחירים, טמפרטורה)

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות f
hints.en: It starts with f

hints.he: יש בה 9 אותיות.
hints.en: It has 9 letters.

explanation.he: לעלות ולרדת, להשתנות שוב ושוב באנגלית: fluctuate. דוגמה: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.
explanation.en: The word is fluctuate (go up and down again and again). Example: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.

word.example: Vegetable prices fluctuate from season to season.

items.prompt: In the desert, temperatures ___ a lot: it is very hot during the day and cold at night.
items.audioText: In the desert, temperatures fluctuate a lot: it is very hot during the day and cold at night.

hints.he: חם ביום, קר בלילה: מה הטמפרטורה עושה?
hints.en: Hot by day, cold at night: what does the temperature do?

explanation.he: fluctuate = לעלות ולרדת. accumulate = להצטבר, cooperate = לשתף פעולה, hesitate = להסס.
explanation.en: Temperatures that go up and down fluctuate.

word.example: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.

items.prompt: plausible
items.audioText: plausible

hints.he: המילה במשפט: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.

explanation.he: plausible פירושה סביר, מתקבל על הדעת. דוגמה: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.
explanation.en: plausible means seeming likely to be true. Example: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.

word.example: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.

items.prompt: מתקבל על הדעת, נשמע אמין

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות p
hints.en: It starts with p

hints.he: יש בה 9 אותיות.
hints.en: It has 9 letters.

explanation.he: סביר, מתקבל על הדעת באנגלית: plausible. דוגמה: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.
explanation.en: The word is plausible (seeming likely to be true). Example: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.

word.example: His excuse sounded plausible, so the teacher believed him.

items.prompt: The detective didn't believe the story because it wasn't ___: nobody can run 20 kilometers in half an hour.
items.audioText: The detective didn't believe the story because it wasn't plausible: nobody can run 20 kilometers in half an hour.

hints.he: למה הבלש לא האמין? אף אחד לא יכול לרוץ כל כך מהר.
hints.en: Why didn't the detective believe it? Nobody can run that fast.
